title: Not as easy to clean as I'd like
text:
Not as easy to clean as I'd like. The noise level is hardly noticeable. It last a loooooong time on the lowest setting so you can have it on all day in a 10x10 room without having to refill (and same for overnight uses).

My biggest and only complaint is that we have hard water and a full run of a tank on the lowest setting stains the inside compartments and I cannot for the life of me fit anything in there (that I own) to clean it out properly.
